nodes.title: Core contracts and runtime
nodes.description: Library-first core: zero-dependency contracts, streams, limits, config, facade. Parity: tika-core.

nodes.title: Detection and MIME registry
nodes.description: 100% detection parity with Tika 4.2 including magic, globs, XML roots, text, ZIP and OLE2 containers.

nodes.title: Metadata schema and serialization
nodes.description: Full tika-metadata-schema parity, write limits, JSON/XML/CSV/XMP serialization.

nodes.title: Output handlers
nodes.description: SAX-shaped event model plus text/html/xhtml/xml/markdown/json handlers with parity.

nodes.title: Parser framework and recursion
nodes.description: Composite/auto-detect parsers, recursive wrapper, embedded extraction, limits, password provider, registry generation.

nodes.title: Core types: MediaType, Attributes, ByteStream, InputSource
nodes.description: Implement immutable MediaType parser/formatter, Attributes, ByteStream and InputSource per spec 01. Acceptance: RFC 2045 round-trip tests, zero deps.

nodes.title: Stream adapters: AsyncIterable, Web, Node, Blob, file
nodes.description: toAsyncIterable/toReadableStream/toNodeReadable/collect with backpressure and limits. Acceptance: interop tests across Node, Bun, Deno, browser.

nodes.title: RipstreamInputStream with lazy memory-to-disk spooling
nodes.description: peek/mark/reset/seek/getFile, threshold spooling, cleanup on abort. Acceptance: random-access parsers work; no full buffer for sequential paths.

nodes.title: ParseContext, typed keys, abort signal, limits
nodes.description: Implement context hierarchy, standard keys, ParseLimits defaults matching upstream. Acceptance: per-parse overrides and child contexts tested.

nodes.title: Error taxonomy and HTTP/status mapping
nodes.description: RipstreamError subclasses per spec 01 section 12, stable codes, server mapping table. Acceptance: every parser error case classified.

nodes.title: Runtime abstraction (node/bun/deno/browser/worker)
nodes.description: Temp files, workers, fetch, digest, clock. Acceptance: capability detection throws typed errors, never at import time.

nodes.title: Event sink, metrics, stats snapshot
nodes.description: RipstreamEvents parse/embedded/detect/warning/limit; non-throwing sinks; counters. Acceptance: no logging by default.

nodes.title: JSON config loader and validation
nodes.description: RipstreamConfig shape, component configs, fail-fast validation, configGeneration cache invalidation. Acceptance: schema fixtures.

nodes.title: 3.x XML config compatibility loader
nodes.description: Parse upstream properties/parsers XML shape for migration. Acceptance: upstream sample configs load.

nodes.title: Plugin loader and component registration
nodes.description: Explicit dynamic imports; parsers/detectors/fetchers/emitters/iterators/reporters exports. Acceptance: no auto-registration, no document-driven code loading.

nodes.title: Initializable/SelfConfiguring lifecycle and validation
nodes.description: initialize/configure semantics, unknown IDs, load error handler, immutable resolved config. Acceptance: duplicate and unknown component tests.

nodes.title: Tika facade: detect/parse/parseToString/parseToStream/parseRecursive
nodes.description: Public convenience API per spec 01 section 11. Acceptance: parity with Tika facade behavior and defaults.

nodes.title: API Extractor report and semver policy
nodes.description: Freeze public API, deprecation policy, no any in public types. Acceptance: API report diff gate and tsd tests.

nodes.title: Generate MIME registry from tika-mimetypes.xml
nodes.description: Build-time generator emits types, aliases, hierarchy, globs, XML roots, magic rules with upstream version + checksum. Acceptance: zero hand edits; regeneration diff job.

nodes.title: Magic rule compiler and matcher
nodes.description: bytes/string/regex/unicodeLE/BE, offset/range/mask/minLength/submatcher, priority ordering. Acceptance: 50k ops/s and prefix truncation tests.

nodes.title: Name/glob/Content-Disposition detection
nodes.description: Case-insensitive globs, compound suffixes, RFC 2231/5987 filenames. Acceptance: parity test for every upstream glob.

nodes.title: Secure XML root element detector
nodes.description: Namespace-aware first-element mapping, no DTD/entities/network. Acceptance: RSS/Atom/KML/GPX/XLIFF/SVG/ODF-flat cases.

nodes.title: Text/binary heuristics and charset detection
nodes.description: BOM, UTF-8 validity, statistical detector, windows-1252 fallback, HTML meta and XML declaration. Acceptance: encoding fixture matrix.

nodes.title: ZIP central-directory container detection
nodes.description: OOXML refinement, ODF mimetype, EPUB, JAR, APK, iWork, plain zip; ZIP64 and corrupt handling. Acceptance: no full extraction; maxZipEntries enforced.

nodes.title: OLE2/CFB root-entry detection
nodes.description: Word/Excel/PowerPoint/MSG/Visio/encrypted OOXML discrimination. Acceptance: upstream fixture set.

nodes.title: Compressors, 7z, RAR, tar, WARC, ISO, AppleSingle, PDF magic
nodes.description: Non-ZIP container sniffing per spec 02. Acceptance: minimal header fixtures and malformed inputs decline safely.

nodes.title: MediaType hierarchy, aliases, supertypes, specificity
nodes.description: isSpecializationOf, registry lookup, alias normalization. Acceptance: parity against upstream MediaTypeRegistry cases.

nodes.title: Custom mimetypes merge and override detector
nodes.description: Overlay custom definitions and OverridingTypeDetector config. Acceptance: later definitions win; source marked custom.

nodes.title: Detection differential suite vs Tika 4.2
nodes.description: Compare type/subtype/charset for full corpus; truncation and wrong-extension cases. Acceptance: 99% parity, failures triaged and documented.

nodes.title: Multi-valued Metadata container
nodes.description: add/set/get/getAll, stable insertion order, clone/merge, typed accessors, no binary payloads. Acceptance: upstream semantics tests.

nodes.title: Generate metadata schema from tika-metadata-schema
nodes.description: Property constants, namespaces, value types, case rules. Acceptance: regeneration diff job; unknown keys preserved.

nodes.title: Namespaces and value types: dc/xmp/pdf/office/cp/media/scientific
nodes.description: All prefixes in spec 02 section 7. Acceptance: key parity against upstream schema.

nodes.title: Date, integer, long, boolean, real coercion
nodes.description: UTC default, ISO-8601, invalid values null. Acceptance: timezone and malformed-value tests.

nodes.title: Metadata write limits, include/exclude filters
nodes.description: Key/value/list/total caps applied at serialization boundary. Acceptance: upstream config mapping tests.

nodes.title: rmeta and single-document JSON serialization
nodes.description: Depth-first records, X-TIKA:content, exception keys, typedMetadata option, jsonShape compat switch. Acceptance: golden parity vs 4.2.

nodes.title: XML metadata serialization
nodes.description: property elements, escaping, invalid XML char replacement. Acceptance: upstream /meta XML comparison.

nodes.title: CSV metadata serialization
nodes.description: RFC 4180 quoting, optional header, 3.x /meta default behavior. Acceptance: golden output.

nodes.title: XMP packet parse and write
nodes.description: DC/PDF namespaces, round-trip, embedded XMP in PDF/images. Acceptance: XMP fixtures.

nodes.title: X-TIKA recursive fields and parse timing
nodes.description: content, embedded_resource_path, embedded_depth, parse_time_millis, digest, exception fields. Acceptance: names and ordering pinned.

nodes.title: Detected vs final Content-Type and charset provenance
nodes.description: Track detector output, overrides, request-header trust. Acceptance: events and metadata agree.

nodes.title: TextContentHandler parity
nodes.description: Block newlines, br, img alt, table tab/newline, list prefixes, nested indentation. Acceptance: golden text diffs across formats.

nodes.title: XHTMLContentHandler well-formed writer
nodes.description: Wrapper, escaping, auto-close, element helpers, nesting validation. Acceptance: XML well-formedness property tests.

nodes.title: HTML serialization handler
nodes.description: HTML5-ish void elements and escaping. Acceptance: /tika/html parity.

nodes.title: Raw XML content handler
nodes.description: Declaration, encoding, no wrapper. Acceptance: encoding tests.

nodes.title: Markdown handler (Tika 4 default)
nodes.description: Streaming events to GFM: headings, lists, tables, code, blockquotes, links, images, page separators. Acceptance: golden parity vs 4.2 defaults.

nodes.title: JSON content handler and shape compatibility
nodes.description: Content + metadata JSON, tika-4 vs rmeta shapes. Acceptance: handler fixtures.

nodes.title: WriteOutContentHandler truncate/throw modes
nodes.description: Default 100k chars, partial output, WriteLimitReachedError semantics. Acceptance: upstream truncation parity.

nodes.title: LinkExtractor and metadata link collection
nodes.description: href/src collection with base handling. Acceptance: HTML/PDF link fixtures.

nodes.title: Tee, decorator chain, XHTML balancing, XMP handler
nodes.description: Fan-out, balancing repairs, XMP serialization. Acceptance: decorator composition tests.

nodes.title: Bounded-queue streaming output and cancellation
nodes.description: parseToStream lazy start, backpressure, cancel aborts parse, errors after bytes. Acceptance: memory and abort tests.

nodes.title: Recursive/rmeta handler and ParseRecord emission
nodes.description: Pre-order records, exception capture, content field. Acceptance: rmeta golden tests.

nodes.title: CompositeParser/DefaultParser selection semantics
nodes.description: Exact then wildcard, registration order, ParserDeclinedError, exception handling. Acceptance: multi-parser fixtures.

nodes.title: AutoDetectParser detect-rewind-parse pipeline
nodes.description: No consumed stream, prefix memoization. Acceptance: stream position tests.

nodes.title: FallbackParser, EmptyParser, ErrorParser
nodes.description: Unknown text fallback, empty success, unsupported error. Acceptance: upstream behavior matrix.

nodes.title: ParserDecorator and MimeFilteringDecorator
nodes.description: Delegate chaining and type filtering. Acceptance: composition tests.

nodes.title: RecursiveParserWrapper and embedded tree
nodes.description: Depth-first ParseRecords, paths, depths, exception capture, metadata. Acceptance: tree parity on Office/PDF/archives.

nodes.title: EmbeddedDocumentExtractor and default policy
nodes.description: shouldParseEmbedded, recursion, text vs media policy. Acceptance: content and media fixtures.

nodes.title: EmbeddedDocumentBytesHandler and embedded resource URIs
nodes.description: Raw byte streaming and embedded: references in handlers. Acceptance: no full buffering.

nodes.title: Global depth/count/byte/time/ratio limit enforcement
nodes.description: Enforce before recursion; emit limit events and exception metadata. Acceptance: bomb corpus.

nodes.title: Parser capabilities: random access, metadata-only, rendering, stateful
nodes.description: Framework behavior per capability; reset of stateful parsers. Acceptance: concurrency tests.

nodes.title: PasswordProvider and empty-password attempt
nodes.description: PDF/Office/S-MIME integration, never prompt. Acceptance: encrypted fixture matrix.

nodes.title: Parser/detector registry generation from upstream service files
nodes.description: Generate supported-type maps; cache with configGeneration. Acceptance: completeness audit vs Tika 4.2 service files.
